name: Pallas Air Oyj
summary: Pallas Air Oyj, established in 1988 and headquartered in Espoo, Finland, specializes in creating advanced solutions for air quality management and ventilation system sanitation. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses personal protective items like surgical face masks and respirators, along with portable air purifiers for individual use. The company also supplies various air purification units for residential and commercial environments, in addition to air-purifying humidifiers. Furthermore, Pallas Air Oyj provides professional-grade equipment engineered for the thorough cleaning of ventilation and duct systems. Serving a broad spectrum of clients, its clientele includes sectors such as healthcare, transport, hospitality, construction, real estate, pharmaceuticals, food industries, public administration, diverse commercial entities, and general consumers. The company adopted its current identity, Pallas Air Oyj, in November 2023, having previously operated as Lifa Air Oyj.
